anyOf.description: The requested preset conflicts with the Session preset.
The id is unusable, already taken, or its composition cannot be installed.
The session's conversation has started, so its composition is fixed.
No configured root supplies the requested id.
The preset ships with the deployment and is not the user's to change.
The provider refused a valid credential write, for example because a read-only source shadows the reference. The details name only the reference, never the value.
The addressed device grant was already revoked.
The presented public key is not a base64 Ed25519 SPKI DER.
The addressed device grant does not exist.
The presented code expired before redemption.
The presented code is unknown or was already redeemed.
The parent is not fully qualified, the name is not one segment, or creation failed.
A child of that name is already there.
The verb needs an interaction the composed backend does not serve.
The target is not fully qualified, or the backend cannot list it.
More than one active Remote declaration owns the requested endpoint.
Named request arguments do not match the endpoint descriptor.
The HTTP carrier returned 401; authenticate with the Host before explicitly retrying the operation.
Owner-side business validation refused the request; `issues` carries portable diagnostics when a codec produced them.
The service has no valid Remote binding for the selected endpoint.
The call was cancelled by the carrier signal or the backend.
The Client connection is not ready to admit this operation; reconnect does not automatically resubmit it.
A Context resolver threw an unclassified failure before business invocation.
The Context resolver found no receiver for the requested identity.
The required scoped Context provider is not available.
The selected Remote method has no available reflection definition.
The HTTP carrier returned 503 for this request; it does not invalidate an otherwise ready generation.
A supplied wire value fails its codec or interaction delivery metadata requirements.
Carrier, dispatch, or unclassified Host failure.
No active Remote method exports the requested endpoint.
An object lookup provider threw an unclassified failure before business invocation.
The object lookup provider found no value for the requested identity.
A required object lookup provider or provider key is unavailable.
The selected provider has no callable implementation of the requested Remote method.
The HTTP carrier returned 403; this refusal does not establish that a device was revoked.
Required application preparation was withdrawn and has no replacement owner.
The supplied or negotiated API protocol is unsupported; update the application before reconnecting.
A live provider does not match the declared owner, wire field or strict type identity.
A stream Remote method returned neither Iterable nor AsyncIterable.
The service required by the Remote endpoint is unavailable.
The Remote signature or invocation mode is incompatible with the selected dispatch path.
Received stream data failed validation; event-generation failure suspends automatic reconnect until explicit recovery.
The request transport was interrupted, a logical stream exhausted carrier retries, or an otherwise unclassified HTTP failure occurred; mutation acceptance may be unknown.
The admitted Host lacks a capability required by discovery or the requested operation.
Host discovery or negotiation data is invalid or inconsistent, so admission is suspended.
The Host discovery protocol is unsupported by this Client.
This delivery can no longer accept an answer; it does not identify which Client settled the interaction.
The Host deadline elapsed before the pending interaction was settled.
A draft provider interrogation refused or failed.
The presented file could not be resolved or the native action failed.
The Host does not provide the requested native file action.
No presented file matches the requested Session event and file index.
The presented file has no verified Host path for the requested action.
An interaction answer does not match the pending revision; the answer is not accepted.
The Agent rejected Prompt admission; reason retains the refusal diagnostic.
A Prompt attachment or model image capability failed admission.
The requested working directory conflicts with the existing Session directory.
The requested Session range has no completed turn from which to fork.
The supplied client time zone is not a supported UTC or IANA zone.
The requested provider or model cannot be selected for the Session.
The named Session does not exist; produced by every layer that resolves a SessionId.
The addressed Prompt is no longer present in the pending queue.
The observed Session title revision is stale; the requested rename is not applied.
The current turn can no longer accept steering from the addressed Prompt.
The requested title fails Session title validation.
The Session exists but could not be attached to the requested Workspace.
The stored revision moved after the caller read it. Its own outcome rather than an invalid request: the caller must re-read and re-apply.
Every seam refusal that is not a stale write: an unregistered or malformed namespace, a read-only provider, schema validation, storage.
Image admission or model image-capability refusal.
The child catalog entry cannot be read because it is corrupt, unsupported or unavailable.
The child cannot admit the requested Prompt or addressed interruption with its current runtime state.
A browser-supplied zone is neither UTC nor a canonical IANA name.
The requested child is unavailable under the addressed parent Session.
The addressed child cannot take a continuation.
No live Agent carries the addressed parent session.
The deployment mounts no session-projection registry.
The claimed parent does not own the addressed child.
The path is not a directory, so it has no children to list.
No entry exists at that path inside the workspace.
The path is not a regular file, so it has no text to read.
The content read so far is not decodable UTF-8 text, or the page carries NUL bytes.
The directory listing path resolves outside the session's workspace root.
The requested page exceeds the configured byte cap; nothing is returned.
An `absolute` address has no Session to authorize its Host call. Raised by the Client provider; the Host never emits it. Session addresses are resolved by the Host without a Client Session summary.

The address is not a `dsh-resource://file/` address in a scope the provider recognizes: `session/<sessionId>/<path>` or `absolute/<absolute path>`. Raised by the Client provider; the Host never emits it.
The requested directory cannot back a Workspace.
The Session or its anchor is not in the Workspace's manual order.
Another Workspace already uses the requested name.
No registration carries that Workspace identity.

title: DeepSeek Harness Remote failure envelope
description: Validates known code details and preserves unknown codes as opaque diagnostics. Acceptance does not imply capability, permission, recovery policy or protocol compatibility. Additional fields are accepted; validators must not discard the original diagnostic.
